_comment: Feature tracking — product 1.0 MVP 100% stable (Ola 6). Phase-2 mesh R&D on #115.

metadata.reconciliation_notes: 2026-07-18 Ola 6 product-1.0 closeout: all 24 features MVP-stable 100%. Phase-2 research (mesh Iroh/Tor/on-chain) remains on EPIC #115 without blocking overall.

features.name: Unified SQLite Storage
features.description: Unified durable storage using SQLite + SQLite-vec for vectors, graph data, and memory persistence
steps: Store high-dimensional vectors for semantic search
Store graph nodes for belief relationships
features.notes: SQLite+sqlite-vec+migrations production. Columnar/VACUUM optional polish out of MVP.

features.name: BM25 + Vector Hybrid Search
features.description: Hybrid Search combining BM25 keyword matching and vector retrieval with RRF merging
steps: Implement BM25 full-text search with FTS5
features.notes: BM25 + Vector search fully integrated. Dynamic RRF weights, LRU cache. Embeddings via cloud (OpenRouter) working. Missing: local embedding fallback on AMD GPU. Fat Search (mem_search without content by default) via Progressive Memory Disclosure (PR #505).

features.name: Belief Graph
features.description: Belief Graph for conceptual relationship mapping and cognitive inference
steps: Implement extraction logic for agent insights
features.notes: Belief graph module complete. Inference engine, hourly decay, JSON/Bincode serialization, Criterion benchmarks. Entity graph indexing moved to background tokio::spawn (2026-06-16).

features.name: MCP Server
features.description: HTTP-first integration with optional Model Context Protocol (MCP) support exposing 12 tools
steps: Expose authenticated HTTP endpoints for memory and code operations
Expose memory search as a tool
Verify connectivity through HTTP and MCP clients
features.notes: Progressive disclosure contract + tools + tests (#655/#656) + descriptors. Production-ready MCP.

features.name: Code Graph Index
features.description: AST-backed code indexing and symbol search through the `code-graph` sidecar crate
steps: Initialize SQLite index for code symbols
features.notes: FTS5 + multi-lang index + plugins fixture. Multi-lang indexer test green.

features.name: Session Management

features.notes: Working in production. Session export, import, and cross-instance sharing via SessionBundle. Context Virtualization Turn Pack (PR #506) — tiered context restore (shallow/medium/deep) working.

features.name: Encryption at Rest

features.notes: AES-256-GCM + Argon2 fully integrated into storage layer (merged PR #90).
